_note: vCAOC tactical data link plan for the OPTASKLINK, built automatically: network moniker, JICO, NTR and effective period, everything the host's .miz puts on the network (AI AWACS as donors, warships and EWR/GCI as notional C2 STNs, other AI Link 16 aircraft, the F/A-18C setup), then the ATO's human flights set in the cockpit (F-16C STNs, A-10C II SADL TNs, AH-64D IDM nets).

sources.CJCSM 6120.01 (JMTOP): OPTASKLINK content: networks, participants and unit numbers, NTR, JICO
sources.DCS mission files: STN_L16, VoiceCallsignLabel/Number, datalinks.Link16 (FA-18C: AIC/FF1/FF2/VOCA/VOCB channels; F-16C: mission/fighter/special channels), SADL_TN + datalinks.SADL (AirKey, GatewayKey), TN_IDM_LB + datalinks.IDM presets

reserved.use: C2 assets (AWACS, JSTARS, ships, GCI) — assigned in the OPTASKLINK header

stn._blocks: A block is the first three octal digits (BBB00-BBB77, 64 STNs). Each flight takes a slot of 8 (BBBS0-BBBS7); the lead is BBBS1, members follow. Slot 0 is not used.

sadlTn: 4-digit octal 0FFM: FF = the A-10C flight's number in the campaign (octal 01-77), M = member 1-7. Unique across the SADL network.

idm._note: Each AH-64D flight gets its own IDM net (preset 1-9); every Apache is also on the common net (preset 10). Originator IDs run across the campaign so they are unique on the common net.

_atoDay: Effective period: the ATO day 0300Z-0259Z holding the mission's vul time (the .miz start time, converted from theater local time).
